tagline: Rise into rhythm with RootFlute’s "Organic Downtempo Live Looping Fusion" Dance Experience.
intro: Drawing from his extensive collection of self made instruments including multi chamber wild shed elk antler flutes, triton shell agave esraj-lyre multi instrument, carbon fiber double slide didgeridoo, shakuhachi, antler clarinet, wild coffee wood elk antler kora, 6 octave agave bass/cello and much more. Rooted in the Om tone of 136.1 Hz and tuned to C# Sharp 432 Hz, RootFlute creates vast celestial soundscapes that transport audiences to new realms.
stats: 290,000 on instagram. 109,000 + 45,000 on Facebook. 17,000 on YouTube. 10,000 on tiktok = 470,000 followers
bio: Inspired by ancient tradition and a blazing curiosity for new possibilities, RootFlute upholds an art nearly lost to time. He crafts instruments from wild-shed antlers, agave stalks, giant triton shells, and ancient mammoth tusks —each one a living extension of nature, vibration, and intention.

Through live looping, he sculpts celestial soundscapes that awaken inner sight, movement, and memory. RootFlute has performed over 200 sound meditations across the globe and has become known for guiding both stillness and celebration.
Follow celestial sounds that bridge ether to earth and join us in the world where anything is possible.
